source.title: Hegseth disputes reports of depleted US missile interceptor stocks

summary: Relays CNN's report, based on a recent inventory assessment, that nearly 80% of THAAD and about half of Patriot interceptors have been used. Hegseth called it "NOT TRUE." CNN's percentages sit on an undisclosed baseline, so they aren't used in the headline numbers.

claims.attribution: CNN, citing sources familiar with a recent inventory assessment
claims.quote: CNN reported that the United States has used nearly 80% of its Terminal High Altitude Area Defense missile stockpile and about half of its Patriot interceptors since the war began, citing sources familiar with a recent inventory assessment.

claims.attribution: CNN, citing sources familiar with a recent inventory assessment
claims.quote: CNN reported that the United States has used nearly 80% of its Terminal High Altitude Area Defense missile stockpile and about half of its Patriot interceptors since the war began, citing sources familiar with a recent inventory assessment.
Responding to a screenshot of a CNN news banner on X, Hegseth dismissed the reporting as “NOT TRUE” and added: “Shame on you.”
